earnings.title: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
highlights: Cash flow from operating activities for the quarter and last twelve months were $1.53 billion and $4.51 billion, respectively, and free cash flow was $1.34 billion and $4.04 billion, respectively; and

quotes.text: KLA’s September quarter beat the midpoint of guidance across all key metrics, demonstrating the accelerated growth we expected for the second half of calendar 2026.
quotes.by: Rick Wallace, president and CEO of KLA Corporation

outlook: Total revenues were $4.14 billion, above the midpoint of the guidance range of $4.0 billion +/- $200 million;
GAAP diluted EPS was $1.18 and non-GAAP diluted EPS was $1.22, both above the midpoints of the respective guidance ranges;
Total revenues are expected to be in a range of $4.7 billion +/- $200 million
GAAP gross margin is expected to be in a range of 61.8% +/- 1.0%

items.heading: We are exposed to risks associated with a weakening in the condition of the financial markets and the global economy.
items.group: Macroeconomic, International Trade, Operational and Regulatory Risks

items.heading: A majority of our total revenues are derived from outside the U.S., and we maintain significant operations outside the U.S. We are exposed to numerous risks as a result of the international nature of our business and operations. We expect these conditions to continue in the foreseeable future.
items.group: Macroeconomic, International Trade, Operational and Regulatory Risks

items.heading: China, and may significantly harm our business, results of operations, financial condition and cash flows, unless we are able to obtain required licenses.

Recently announced and future U.S. tariffs, retaliatory trade measures and other trade restrictions, as well as uncertainty regarding tariff authority, implementation and refund processes, may have a material adverse impact on our results of operations.

We might be involved in claims or disputes related to IP or other confidential information that may be costly to resolve, prevent us from selling or using the challenged technology and seriously harm our operating results and financial condition.
We are exposed to various risks related to the legal, regulatory and tax environments in which we perform our operations and conduct our business.
